title: Clawd X Digest
summary: Football Transfers & Valuations: Major market shifts in the Bundesliga and Premier League as Harry Kane's contract talks loom and Michael Olise's valuation hits €150m.
AI Agent Progress: The launch of DeepSWE benchmarks and GPT 5.5's 70% success rate signal a move toward agents capable of handling long-horizon, complex engineering tasks.
Developer Tools Evolution: New capabilities in Grok Build, DeepSeek V4 Flash, and automated code review skills are accelerating the 'vibe coding' to professional production pipeline.
Manchester City Crisis: Increasing speculation regarding the 115 Premier League charges and the potential for a mass exodus following Pep Guardiola's departure.
Corporate Temporal Conflict: Marvel Rivals announces the 'Alchemax Headquarters' battlefield, blending tactical genetic research lore with optic blast energy mechanics.

items.title: @Chrisgpt: DeepSWE and GPT 5.5 Performance
items.body: The release of the DeepSWE benchmark reveals that top-tier models like GPT 5.5 are reaching 70% proficiency in long-horizon engineering tasks, including multi-file edits and debugging loops. This highlights a significant shift from simple code completion to autonomous repo-level understanding.

items.title: @xai: Grok Build Beta Launch
items.body: xAI has released Grok Build in Beta for SuperGrok and X Premium+ users, introducing a Plan Mode, image/video generation with Imagine, and a CLI for building automations and orchestrators. The tool is designed to move AI assistance beyond chat into integrated development workflows.

items.title: @Teknium: DeepSeek V4 Flash Availability
items.body: DeepSeek V4 Flash has returned to the Nous Portal as a free resource for the Hermes Agent. This provides developers with a high-speed, low-latency alternative for agentic workflows and real-time processing.

items.title: @MSFTResearch: Agentic GitHub Workflows
items.body: Microsoft Research has unveiled a suite of new tools including MagenticLite and verification-first agents. These research outputs focus on making AI agents more reliable within existing GitHub workflows and economic transitions.

items.title: @MarvelRivals: Alchemax Headquarters Battlefield
items.body: Marvel Rivals is set to launch the Alchemax Headquarters map on May 28th, featuring a high-stakes environment where past and future collide. The map integrates Miguel O'Hara's genetic labs and Cyclops' optic energy as core environmental mechanics.

items.title: @iMiaSanMia: Bayern Player Valuation Shifts
items.body: Transfermarkt's latest update shows Michael Olise's market value soaring to €150m and Pavlovic reaching €90m, while veteran stars like Harry Kane, Kimmich, and Musiala see slight downward adjustments. This reflects a broader shift toward younger talent in the Bayern squad.

items.title: @The_Forty_Four: Man City 115 Charges Verdict
items.body: Speculation is mounting that a verdict on Manchester City's 115 financial charges could arrive before or during the World Cup. The uncertainty is being linked to the departure of Pep Guardiola and key staff members, signaling potential structural changes at the club.

items.title: @iMiaSanMia: Harry Kane Contract Strategy
items.body: Bayern CEO Jan-Christian Dreesen is leading negotiations to extend Harry Kane's contract. While the club targets 2029, Kane's camp is pushing for certainty until 2030, emphasizing his desire to secure one of the final major contracts of his professional career.

items.title: @Outrage_Tactics: Real Madrid's Saka Warning
items.body: Reports indicate Real Madrid has issued a ultimatum to Arsenal regarding Bukayo Saka, suggesting they will either pay €100m now or wait to sign him for free at the end of his projected contract. This highlights Madrid's aggressive long-term recruitment strategy for Premier League stars.

items.title: @Qiqi7877: The Legacy of Jane Newton
items.body: A viral thread recounts the historical impact of Jane Newton, a seamstress who supported the wrongly accused 'Scottsboro Boys' in 1931. Her simple act of teaching them to write their names eventually allowed the last survivor to sign his own exoneration papers in 2023.

items.title: @MadridXtra: Xabi Alonso's Message to Guler
items.body: Arda Güler revealed that Xabi Alonso reached out to express pride in his performance following Real Madrid's match against Bayern. The exchange highlights the respect between the rising star and the highly-regarded manager.

items.title: @footballcritix: Cavani's Secret Charity
items.body: Details have emerged regarding Edinson Cavani's PSG contract, where he reportedly eschewed goal bonuses in favor of the club secretly donating 500 bicycles and footballs annually to impoverished children in his hometown of Salto.

items.title: @Kiradavis: The Origins of Liberty Think Tanks
items.body: A discussion on the lineage of free-market ideas traces the founding of The Manhattan Institute back to Sir Anthony Fisher and his WWII-era correspondence with economist F.A. Hayek, emphasizing the strategy of changing ideas before changing politics.
